design_note: docs/ORIGIN_OF_LIFE_ENGINE_DESIGN.md: §0.1, §0.2a (the lead's rulings, amended 17 November 2026: the last molecule's rate is the pair rule in its cancelled form, in either direction), §2.1-2.4, §3.3, §7.1-7.2

conventions.rule: every bundle and probe declares every token; a missing or unknown token is refused (status 2)

worlds.refusals: designs/refusals/*.world.json: each must be refused at parse

OL1-1.claim: every channel keeps local detailed balance (§0.1, §7.1)

inputs.states: probes.kernel_probe_states (written by make-probes; echoed by the engine)

checks: Kolmogorov on every registered square and two-cycle (convention-free)
ln a-(n') - ln a+(n) = F(n') - F(n) - w under the declared tokens
reverse rates equal the reference's (the extinct boundary's continued form included)
OL1-1.tolerance: 64 u (8 + Sum|ln a|) per cycle; 64 u (4 + |ln a+| + |ln a-| + |DeltaF|) per edge
planted: a literal zero for the last molecule's rate under extinct

OL1-2.claim: a closed world relaxes to exp(-F/k_BT) (§7.1)

inputs.states: probes.closed_world_states from the world's initial state (387 states)

checks: exact edge identity in the reference (RatExp)
the engine table's stationary law against exp(-F)/Z
Kolmogorov on every square of the closed world
both closed-world tables relax to exp(-F)/Z
identical channel sequence, times exactly halved (bitwise)
planted: the factor on forward channels only

a_forward_form.check: a+ equals k g(m) E(m) theta+(n) under the declared tokens

b_large_system.cut: the state after the last event at or before each time
b_large_system.streams: independent, one per run; none shared
b_large_system.null: the exact master-equation mean on each rung (not the ODE)
b_large_system.test: two-sided z on each mean, Bonferroni over 16 (z = 4.003)

planted: reverse channels selected at 0.9 of their weight

checks: every moiety conserved at every row, held exchange counted from the trace

OL1-5.claim: the ledgers for reactions close: F(n_t) - F(n_0) = W_t - Q_t at every row (§3.3)

run.fission: none (no fission threshold is reached, or none declared)

OL1-5.tolerance: 2 [16 u E (1 + L) + gamma_E (Sum|q| + Sum|w|) + 4 u (|F_t| + |F_0|)] (ledger.py)

OL1-6.claim: streams: bitwise replay; distinct identities share no uniforms (§7.1)
